narrative.intro: Humana Government Business obligated $5.6B in federal contracts in FY26 to date. Obligations fell 13.5% year over year. Contracting activity in the current fiscal year is concentrated in a small number of large awards: awardCount is 2 and averageAwardSize is $2.8B. Historical obligations show a peak in FY24 at $8B, with earlier fiscal years at $7.8B in FY23, $7.7B in FY22, and $7.1B in FY21. Obligations dropped to $6.5B in FY25 before the current-year total of $5.6B. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). This profile indicates a vendor with multi-year, high-dollar awards and lower transaction counts in the current reporting window. Review of contract-level documents is required to tie these totals to specific awards, task orders, or agencies because the figures here are aggregate obligations and the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables use award-value figures that are total contract values rather than year-to-date obligations.
